name: Sword Master - Legends of the Blade
summary:
Step into the arena and become the ultimate multi-disciplinary warrior in **Sword Master: Legends of the Blade**. This is the definitive VR combat experience that lets you master the most iconic fighting styles in human history. From the disciplined strikes of the East to the brutal power of the West, the world’s greatest weapons are now in your hands.
